scope: Read-only investigation of the actual Codex application hook loading and tool dispatch route; no configuration, source, process restart, or model invocation changes
finding: The on-disk hook and trust record are valid for the application-bundled engine. Reflection into the already-running application session remains unproven; stale runtime hook configuration is the leading hypothesis, not a confirmed root cause.

freshBundledEngineDiscovery.method: initialize followed by hooks/list in a separate diagnostic app-server process using the same application-bundled executable
freshBundledEngineDiscovery.interpretation: Rules out a discovery error or cross-version trust-hash mismatch in this fresh-process check. Does not inspect the hook snapshot of the already-loaded conversation or prove a tool was blocked.

bundledApplicationCode.reloadParameterSchemaDescription: When true, hot-reload updated runtime settings into loaded threads after writing. Session-static model, reasoning-effort, Plan-mode reasoning-effort, service-tier, and personality defaults are not reloaded.
bundledApplicationCode.activeDisplayComputation: trustStatus === managed OR (enabled AND trustStatus === trusted)
bundledApplicationCode.activeDisplayMeaning: Derived from configuration metadata, not an observed hook invocation or successful denied-edit probe.
bundledApplicationCode.limitation: Packaged code establishes an intended client path, not that this path was invoked by the active VS Code session.

logEvidenceLimit.interpretation: No hook-target log rows were found for this thread in the retained database. This is not proof that no hook ever ran; successful runs may not be logged there.

hypotheses.name: Already-loaded application thread did not refresh discovered hooks and/or trust after external CLI approval
hypotheses.basis: Live application predates hook creation; approval was made in another process; fresh same-version discovery succeeds; app trust code explicitly requests runtime reload.
hypotheses.notYetProven: The live thread's in-memory hook set has not been directly inspected.

hypotheses.name: Runtime dispatch or hook startup defect
hypotheses.basis: The live edit was not blocked. Configuration discovery alone cannot distinguish skipped hooks, startup failure, or a dispatch defect.

officialScope: Code-mode nested calls are documented as hook-covered; code mode is not intrinsically exempt. Some specialized paths can opt out. This investigation does not establish such an opt-out for the observed call.
nextDiagnostic: Reload configuration in the actual application host or restart its extension session under owner direction, then repeat the same live denied-edit probe. If it still writes, capture hook started/completed or startup error evidence from that host and distinguish dispatch failure from guard-process failure.
noAutomaticRemediation: No hook disabling, trust bypass, update, settings write, live thread resume, or application restart was performed.
